title: Add topic and date range filters to DLQPage
description:
DLQPage has pagination but no filtering. Add filters to help operators find specific failed jobs.

**Implementation:**
- Add filter bar above the table with: topic text input (debounced), date range presets (1h/24h/7d/30d)
- Update `useDLQ()` hook to accept and pass filter params as query params
- Reset pagination when filters change
- Show active filter count badge

**Files:** `dashboard/src/pages/DLQPage.tsx`, `dashboard/src/hooks/useDLQ.ts`

implementationPlan.description: In dashboard/src/hooks/useDLQ.ts: Update useDLQ() to accept optional filter params (topic?: string, since?: string) and append them as query params to GET /dlq request. When filters change, the queryKey changes automatically which resets pagination.
implementationPlan.note: Added topic and since fields to DLQFilters, passed as query params in buildParams. queryKey already includes filters so cache invalidates on change.

implementationPlan.description: In dashboard/src/pages/DLQPage.tsx: Add a filter bar above the table with: (1) topic Input with 400ms debounce, (2) date range preset buttons (1h/24h/7d/30d/All), (3) active filter count badge, (4) clear filters button. Pass filter values to useDLQ(). Reset cursor/page when filters change via useEffect.
implementationPlan.note: Added filter bar with debounced topic input (400ms), time range preset pills (1h/24h/7d/30d/All), active filter count badge, clear button. Pagination resets on filter change via useEffect. Filters passed to useDLQ().
